n, m = map(int, input().split())
mod = 998244353

def invl(a, mod):
    b = mod
    p = 1
    q = 0
    while b > 0:
        c = a // b
        d = a
        a = b
        b = d % b
        temp = p
        p = q
        q = temp - c * q
    return p + mod if p < 0 else p

def guessFrac(n, mod):
    min_value = mod
    argnum = -1
    argden = 0
    for den in range(1, 200001):
        num = (n * den) % mod
        if num * 2 >= mod:
            num -= mod
        if abs(num) + den < min_value:
            min_value = abs(num) + den
            argnum = num
            argden = den
    if argden == 0:
        return None
    return (argnum, argden)

ans = (1 + invl(m + 1, mod) * n) % mod
base = invl(m + 1, mod) * ((m * (m + 2 + (n - 1))) % mod) % mod
sumInv = 0
for i in range(1, n + 1):
    sumInv += invl(i, mod)
    sumInv %= mod

ans = (base * sumInv + ans) % mod
print(ans)
